lede: Tuesday night, Town Council takes up third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — a vote that would rewrite the Land Use Code's rules on historic review, landscaping, and tree maintenance to meet state wildfire mitigation standards, the kind of quiet change that has real consequences for property owners across town. Ridgway's council is also busy Wednesday with a public hearing on the Hyde Subdivision resubdivision and a joint session on its new Housing Action Plan. Meanwhile, Mushroom Festival kicks off midweek and the Open Space Commission walks the Bear Creek Trailhead Monday to scout a new trail alignment.

notable.stake: Third-reading vote could permanently change landscaping and historic review rules.
Public hearing on Hyde Subdivision resubdivision plus housing plan joint work session.
Energy code update would revise building standards for new construction and major renovations.
